study: dynamic-arm root cause: per-subsystem force decomposition

sigma0_control.note: sigma->0, no Laplace compression, delta_sph=0: stays at rest (round 6 regression), so the integrator + axis + continuity are clean; the runaway needs the Laplace-compressed surface.

verdict.csf_role: secondary; its radial mean is small and outward
verdict.root_cause: the Laplace-compressed initial state carries a sharp surface pressure gradient (p_lap -> 0 over ~2h) that the SPH pressure-gradient operator amplifies into an acoustic pulse; |a_press|max grows 26.9 -> 83.4 over the first 40 steps while |a_csf|max stays ~17-25. The runaway is therefore an acoustic startup instability of the compressible initial state, not a defect of the CSF operator alone.
